note: Input-controlled UF2 block flags decide whether the extension-tag parser runs.

The loop only checks that at least one byte remains, but the parser later reads a 4-byte tag header from the same offset; the safety obligation is that enough bytes remain for the header before reading it.
When the loop reaches a truncated extension tag, this 4-byte read goes past the end of the chunk and triggers the heap-buffer-overflow read.
